meeting.title: Joint data platform intro
meeting.summary: Intro call with data leads from two customers who know each other; compared notes on rollout approach and agreed to swap pilot learnings.
action_items: Theo to send the pilot rollout checklist to both teams
Dara and Elena to swap pilot survey templates
key_decisions: Both teams will run a two-week pilot before wider rollout
meeting.notes: Informal joint call — both data leads asked for the same rollout checklist.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Thanks both for joining — you asked for an intro since you're at similar stages of rollout.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: Yeah, we're about to pick our pilot group and I heard Elena's team already ran theirs.

transcript.speaker: Elena Voss
transcript.text: We did a two-week pilot with eight engineers. The survey at the end was the most useful part.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: How did you pick the eight?

transcript.speaker: Elena Voss
transcript.text: People who already asked data questions in Slack every week. Self-selected power users.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: That matches what we see elsewhere. A pilot of five to ten heavy users, two weeks, then a survey before wider rollout.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, we'll do the same — two-week pilot before we open it up.

transcript.speaker: Elena Voss
transcript.text: Same here for our second wave. Theo, you mentioned a rollout checklist you use with customers?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Yes — I'll send the pilot rollout checklist to both of your teams after this call.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: Appreciate it. Elena, could you share your pilot survey template too?

transcript.speaker: Elena Voss
transcript.text: Sure, I'll send you our survey template this week, and I'd love yours back once you've adapted it.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Great — short and useful. I'll leave you two connected and follow up separately in your own syncs.

expected.notes: Edge case: attendees span two cast-company domains (modal.com + raycast.com) and no other signal disambiguates — must land as matchAmbiguous in 'Needs your input' with no drafts until manually assigned.
